other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes various feature engineering statistics (like TF-IDF vocabularies, SVD components, group aggregations, and median imputation values) on the entire training set prior to splitting it into cross-validation folds. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold evaluations overly optimistic and potentially degrading the generalization of the final ensemble.

summary: The agent has written a highly advanced and robust pipeline, including deep learning, gradient boosting, temporal features, text embeddings, and a custom SLSQP ensembling strategy. It correctly avoids leaking the holdout Kaggle test set into the training process. The only notable flaw is cross-validation leakage: certain aggregations, TF-IDF/SVD transforms, and median imputations are fitted on the entire training dataset before the K-Fold split, which leaks validation fold statistics into the training folds.
